content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to programming with [company_name]. I'm planning to install a [company_name] [product_name] controller on a production line. My goal is to use two digital inputs (up and down) to control a 0–10V analog output. Each press should increase or decrease the output voltage by 0.2V, or continuously adjust the voltage at a steady rate if the input is held. The analog output will then control a proportional pneumatic valve to regulate pressure between 0 and 6 Bar for a brake system. Can anyone provide advice on how to convert digital signals to an analog output for this application?
Please refer to the attached file.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is asking for help configuring a [company_name] [product_name] controller to convert digital inputs into a variable 0–10V analog output, featuring stepwise or continuous changes. The main insight is that the digital-to-analog setup may be challenging for those new to this hardware, and documentation or guidance for such tasks appears limited.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward method to use digital input buttons for stepped or continuous control of an analog output signal with [company_name] [product_name] hardware and software.
feature_keywords: digital input to analog output conversion
